source: 2026-10-20 explicit user request; supplements HTML Welcome and Community, not an original prototype screen
approved_deltas: Shared AgreementSheet: remove bottom Close; use existing source X SVG in a fixed top-right 44px hit area, title and X outside document scroll.
First launch without current consent opens a themed, scrollable EULA confirmation over Welcome. No default agreement, outside dismissal or automatic acceptance.
Agree and Continue saves document revisions and timestamp through Store after custom 500ms Loading; Welcome checkbox reads the same persisted state. Not Now leaves both auth entries gated.
Unchecking revokes consent via Store. Checking again opens EULA. Reading and closing documents does not accept. Refresh/relaunch restores only successfully saved consent.
Existing accounts need one explicit agreement when no acceptance exists; their session and entities are preserved. A valid session resumes its existing destination after agreement.

New EULA uses formal English, campus eligibility, content ownership, mutual consent, zero tolerance for abusive/objectionable content, reporting/blocking, event safety, purchases and data rights. It does not invent remote delivery, moderation response times, a legal operator or contact. Existing Terms/Privacy/Guidelines remain canonical and unchanged.

design.geometry_basis: existing theme card, typography, source close SVG and confirmation motion; rpx = CSS px * 750/393
design.safe_areas: measured top and bottom; inner content scroll only

state.migration: add missing field without accepting or overwriting existing entities
state.failure: retain previous state and show retryable error
